context: Tests whether the agent produces correctly structured eval scenarios for a straightforward skill

checklist.name: directory-naming
checklist.description: All scenario directories use descriptive kebab-case names

checklist.name: scenario-json-present
checklist.description: Every scenario directory contains a valid scenario.json with a description field

checklist.name: criteria-json-structure
checklist.description: Every criteria.json has context, type set to weighted_checklist, and a checklist array

checklist.name: weights-sum-to-100
checklist.description: Every criteria.json has checklist weights that sum to exactly 100

checklist.name: task-md-two-sections
checklist.description: Every task.md contains Problem/Feature Description and Output Specification sections

checklist.name: task-no-skill-reference
checklist.description: No task.md references the skill being tested by name or hints at expected behaviors

checklist.name: scenario-diversity
checklist.description: Scenarios cover at least one happy-path case and one edge case or failure scenario

checklist.name: criteria-binary-verifiable
checklist.description: All checklist descriptions are specific enough for binary pass/fail scoring
